Keywords: calculator, estimate, savings, cost, quiz, tool, result, input, roi, quote
Section Order: What you will learn > The inputs, three at most > Live result with the assumptions shown > Save or send the result > What to do next
Primary CTA Placement: The result panel carries the action; a second link sits in the header
Color Strategy: Plain ground; result number in the strongest contrast on the page
Recommended Effects: Result updates as inputs change, with the change announced politely; no counting animation
Conversion Optimization: Show the working and the source of every rate; ask for contact details after the result, not before; allow a result with no sign-up
Use When: The visitor's own numbers are the best argument
Avoid When: The sums are guesses you cannot back
Mobile: Inputs stack above the result; numeric keyboards
Accessibility: Labels and units on every input; result in live region (SC 4.1.3); errors in words (SC 3.3.1)
Slop Habits: a gated result that asks for a phone number first; inflated savings built on invented rates

Keywords: video, explainer, introduction, demo reel, founder, captions, transcript, watch, story
Section Order: Plain headline > Video with captions and poster > Transcript and key points in text > Proof > Next step
Primary CTA Placement: Under the video and again in the transcript area
Color Strategy: Dark or plain frame around the video; no competing colour
Recommended Effects: Click to play; never autoplay with sound
Conversion Optimization: Say how long the video runs; give the same facts in text for people who will not press play; host it so it starts fast
Use When: Seeing and hearing the thing explains it best
Avoid When: The audience is on slow data or the message fits in three sentences
Mobile: Video fills the width; captions on by default
Accessibility: Captions and transcript (SC 1.2.2, 1.2.1); no autoplay (SC 1.4.2); controls reachable by keyboard
Slop Habits: a looping background video behind the headline; a stock drone clip with no link to the business
